title: oddsapiio: Official R client for Odds-API.io
description: Official R client for Odds-API.io, a real-time sports betting odds API covering 450+ bookmakers, 34 sports and 12,000+ leagues. The package returns sports, markets, events, odds, odds movements and summaries, value bets, arbitrage bets, dropping odds, historical odds and closing lines, settlement grades, outrights and bookmaker id mappings as tidy data frames using httr2. Maintained by Outlier AS. Documentation at https://docs.odds-api.io.
